bundle_identity.recipe: Sort these member names lexically; for each compute {path,bytes,sha256}; receiver_bundle_sha256=SHA256(canonical codec of that ordered entry list).
bundle_identity.source_admission_owner: root; receiver compares producer binding with independently supplied expected_binding and does not self-attest its executing source.

caller_owned_admission: Confirm exact source/schema/interface bundle bytes and bounded same-job execution before launch.
Supply binding independently of producer/public data: exact run, attempt, job, host instance/image, platform, source commit, receiver bundle, identities, architecture and contract pins.
Admit the episode descriptor and the three input descriptors; maintain the same admitted process/job and host instance through both independent cuts.
Supply a dedicated private directory with only D0_PRIVATE_RECEIPT.json, no existing receiver outputs; directory owner equals the bound effective uid/gid and mode0700.
Separately arrange affected review and any later producer/harness composition. This derivation does not perform or authorize either.

carriers.creation: Fixed names, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK, exact write, fsync, full byte readback, FD/path identity and owner/mode/link recheck.
carriers.failure: May retain an incomplete output on an output failure. No atomic two-output commit, overwrite, cleanup or retry claim. Reconcile/newly admit a fresh attempt before reuse.
carriers.inventory: Names only in this dedicated admitted private directory; never stat/open unexpected entries. Three literal files plus the private directory count as four retained entries.64 is not additional host-path authority.

codec.canonical_identity_digest: SHA256 over canonical JSON of physical target path, physical ancestors, full target identity, whole-body length/hash, first20-byte header fact, ELF projection, capability fact and access fact; requested alias spelling and alias traversal do not change this digest.
codec.decoder: Reject duplicate keys, noncanonical bytes, non-ASCII encoding, floats/NaN/infinity, integer text longer than20 digits excluding sign, depth>20, booleans in integer positions, missing/unknown fields, invalid enum/null combinations and overlong arrays. Full semantic predicates remain mandatory.
codec.encoding: ASCII JSON using ensure_ascii=True, sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=False, exactly one trailing LF
codec.private_digest: SHA256 over every actual byte of D0_PRIVATE_RECEIPT.json, including the final LF; the private receipt does not embed this digest.

command_interface.descriptor_population: Four distinct already-open descriptors >=3, retained across the admitted launch. Episode is an independently admitted directory; the others are independently admitted regular input files. No arbitrary path arguments.

exit_codes.0: Complete observation, regardless of positive or negative eligibility. Read the decision.
exit_codes.2: Incomplete or refused observation, including startup/admission failures.

command_interface.flag_authority: The flag is a guard against accidental invocation; it does not establish permission, currentness, same-job identity or effect admission.
command_interface.stdout: Only closed observation/eligibility/reason codes and optional numeric errno. No receipt body, inspected content or source diagnostic text.

dependencies.runtime: Python3 standard library on separately admitted Linux with the listed POSIX primitives; no third-party runtime dependency.
dependencies.schema_generation: emit_schemas.py imports inert local definitions and emits four closedschemas with absolute string anchors; unchanged public schema is copied byte-for-byte.
dependencies.synthetic_controls: python -B controls.py; in-memory adapter and evidence carrier only; never invokes PosixIO.

metadata_policy.bin_ancestor: Only selected /bin ancestor to protected physical /usr/bin under8/16 bounds; full lstat/readlink/target/physical-directory bookends.
metadata_policy.other_metadata_ancestor_alias: Incomplete/refused; no fallback or general alias expansion.
metadata_policy.profile_d: lstat-only root, no listing or child recursion.
metadata_policy.six_informational_leaves: lstat-only; no readlink of leaf, target following, body opens/hashes, executable checks or capability queries; leaf kind/owner/presence do not determine eligibility.

python_api.io_override: Only for independent in-memory controls. Production composition must admit the POSIX adapter and exact source; an arbitrary injected adapter proves no host fact.
python_api.return: closed D0_ELIGIBILITY.schema.json decision after output readback

review_limits: Absent public row alias_hops=0 is preserved from the immutable public relation; private receipt retains a selected /bin ancestor traversal. Affected review must confirm this projection against the late clarification.

Alias target spellings containing empty, dot or dot-dot components are conservatively refused before target reads. No lexical simplification substitutes a different POSIX path; expanded coverage requires an explicit revised derivation/review.

The8MiB private carrier and dedicated three-file container are concrete receiver bounds, not claims that every theoretical maximum-size contract-shaped tree fits or that arbitrary existing evidence directories are accepted.
Counts and byte bounds do not guarantee a syscall wall-clock deadline. Root owns runtime/scheduling admission. No actual POSIX host execution or changed producer compatibility was tested here.

same_job_recut.claim_limit: Current independent same-job cuts reproduce the retained producer final cut; they do not prove the historical producer first cut, eliminate arbitrary ABA changes or create a global simultaneous snapshot.

sequence: Validate root binding, effective identities, platform and unchanged public-schema hash.
Admit private directory and fixed carrier physically; read complete private bytes with EOF and stable FD/path bookends.
Strictly parse private/public carriers; verify binding, rebuild public facts from retained private evidence and match by unique fixed identity.
For complete producer observation only, independently observe the same14 fixed endpoints twice through the receiver policy.
Validate each cut and require both receiver cuts to equal each other and the producer retained final cut, apart from successful read chunk partition.
Derive observation completeness independently of eligibility.
Re-read unchanged producer carrier; write and read back fixed independent receipt and digest-bound decision; check final private directory and entry inventory.
